
```{r pkgs, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(IPDfromKM)
library(survival)
library(KMtoIPD)
library(png)
library(tidyverse); theme_set(theme_bw())
```

```{r seed}
set.seed(427)
```


```{r}
data(imgexp) 

windows()

df_raw <- getpoints(imgexp, x1 = 70, x2 = 0, y1 = 0, y2 = 100)
```

```{r}
df2 <- df_raw[order(df_raw$x), ]

t_all <- df2$x
S_all <- df2$y / 100 

```

```{r}
n_total <- 213  

ipd <- getIPD(
  n      = n_total,
  t      = t_all,
  S      = S_all,
  cens.t = NA  
)

head(ipd)
nrow(ipd)
table(ipd$event)
```

```{r}
fit_recon <- survfit(Surv(t, event) ~ 1, data = ipd)

plot(fit_recon, xlab = "Time", ylab = "Survival",
     conf.int = FALSE, mark.time = TRUE)
```
